Babita is reluctant to leave Gokuldham, but Iyer explains that refusing his promotion and transfer to Chennai would cost him his job. Later at Sodhi’s house, while the society men gather expecting a promotion party, Iyer drops the bombshell that he and Babita are moving to Chennai in just two days.
Step into Jethalal’s world with Gada Electronics! Manage the shop, tackle quirky customers, and experience nonstop TMKOC-style fun.
Are you ready for the challenge?
